name: Millionaire Mansion
source:
Welcome to Millionaire Mansion!

One day while aimlessly browsing the web, you signed up to possibly be a contestant on a new reality show, where the ultimate prize is an exotic mansion and millions of dollars. A real life changing prize!

You quickly forgot about it, thinking it to be some scam for your details as you had never heard of the show before. However weeks later you get a call, you're in! A car comes to pick you up and take you to the mansion where you will be staying while competing. 

You quickly learn that you are the only male contestant in this show, and that the quick to anger director of the show may have ulterior motives for the show.

What challenges are in store for the contestants? Will you find love among the cast and/or crew? Will you win Millionaire Mansion?

[From [url=https://fetpop-games.itch.io/millionaire-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到百万富翁大厦！

有一天，当你漫无目的地浏览网页时，你报名参加了一个新的真人秀节目，最终的奖品是一座异国情调的豪宅和数百万美元。改变现实生活的奖品！

你很快就忘记了它，并认为这是对你的详细信息的骗局，因为你以前从未听说过该节目。然而几周后你接到电话，你就加入了！一辆汽车来接你并带你前往比赛期间住宿的豪宅。

你很快就会发现，你是这个节目中唯一的男性参赛者，而容易愤怒的节目导演可能对这个节目别有用心。

参赛者面临哪些挑战？你会在演员和/或工作人员中找到爱情吗？你会赢得百万富翁豪宅吗？
